name: What is the average cost of replacing an exterior door?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of replacing an exterior door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of replacing an exterior door varies widely based on several factors, including the material (e.g., fiberglass, steel, wood), style, size, hardware, and any custom features. A basic steel or fiberglass entry door might start from around $800-$1,500 installed, while high-end custom wood doors with intricate designs could range from $3,000 to over $10,000. These figures include labor, but specific costs are best determined with a detailed quote after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior door replacement costs vary from $800 to over $10,000, depending on material, style, size, and custom features.
